title: Inverted slippage protection approach can lead to problems
summary: ## Severity  **Likelihood:** Low, because it needs more than one special condition simultaneously  **Impact:** Medium, because it can lead to limited amount of funds lost from the protocol  ## Description  Both the `leaveETH` and `leave` methods use the `slippage` storage variable to implement slippage protection for the users leaving the vault. The problem is that the slippage protection is done in an unusual approach which can result in problems.
